name: FireBirdPair
fix_description: In _firebirdSwapToken, swap executed with insufficient slippage protection. Fix: set reasonable amountOutMin based on oracle price.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step DeFi attack involving a flash loan, repeated reserve manipulation on a specific LP, abuse of protocol fee collection logic, and a final no-slippage reserve-fund sale before unwinding. It requires understanding protocol-specific Firebird pair/reserve-fund mechanics rather than just spotting a generic bug, but the PoC itself is still fairly compact and not deeply stateful enough to be hard.
